visual.label: Visual expressiveness
visual.effect: Quiet heading or larger heading with an accent rule.

layout.label: Layout experimentation
layout.effect: Full-width work list or a list beside its contextual editor.

density.label: Information density
density.effect: Changes row padding and section spacing, never hides information.

colour.label: Colour expressiveness
colour.effect: Changes the accessible accent and tint palette.

motion.label: Motion intensity
motion.effect: Immediate changes or a 160 ms feedback entrance; reduced motion always wins.

typography.label: Typography
typography.effect: System sans throughout or serif headings with sans controls.

surface.label: Surface treatment
surface.effect: White workspace or a softly tinted workspace ground.

components.label: Component styling
components.effect: Square or gently rounded controls and status markers.

interaction.label: Interaction experimentation
interaction.effect: Apply a status filter with a button or filter immediately on change.

conformity.label: Design system conformity
conformity.effect: Baseline border and link treatment or heavier section rules and accent navigation.
